nonfailure_sites.category: staff alert label; repeats the operation's already-classified stop code, emits no new failure
nonfailure_sites.source: At the owner retry cap (plan B4) the stuck-founder alert is queued with the stop code the preparation already recorded through prepare_failure; it classifies nothing.

nonfailure_sites.category: receipt counter bookkeeping; records the stop code already on the receipt
nonfailure_sites.source: The never-reset stop streak (plan B4) keys identical stops by the receipt's own reason_code or failure.code; it is a counter, not a failure emission.

nonfailure_sites.category: stop_v1 bookkeeping; copies the stop code already on the receipt
nonfailure_sites.source: The sticky-stop record (plan B3) copies the receipt's own reason_code so a later push can judge whether it can change the outcome; it classifies nothing.
